name: Biswanath Kundu

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Biswanath Kundu is a Kolkata poet whose literary work also includes criticism and translation. Alongside Sabita Chakraborty, he translated fourteen short stories by K. V. Dominic into Bengali for Nirbachito Chotogalpo. The book’s introduction, written by Ramesh Chandra Mukhopadhyaya, also discusses Kundu’s English collection Poetry Dot 6, illustrated by Dominique de Miscault. His poems “Mirage” and “Life begins at sixty” appear in Creative Flight’s April 2025 issue.

His Kabita Live contributions use rhyme and direct argument to explore shared life. “Reel life vs Real life” questions the passage from screen entertainment into everyday expectations, while “Mutual trust and understanding” traces cooperation through learning, work and family. “Needs of Gender Studies” extends this concern towards equality and the freedom to choose one’s own path.
